page.notes: The text is printed in long s; transcribed as plain s. The second line of the "Nota" note is a ditto mark („) only, not text. The catchword "sis," is partly cut off at the bottom right and is read from its visible letters. "Reliqua" is read from the scan; the letters are slightly blurred. Printed accents and ligatures are not reproduced.
